Roll up a vector of status strings to a single status

rollup_statuses.Rd

Priority: flag > no_flag > insufficient_evidence > no_data. A mix of no_flag and no_data (or insufficient_evidence) collapses to insufficient_evidence.

Usage

rollup_statuses(statuses)

Arguments

statuses

A character vector of status values.

Value

A single status string.
